verses.sa: ईशा वास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किं च जगत्यां जगत्। तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्य स्विद्धनम्॥
verses.tr: īśā vāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ yatkiṃ ca jagatyāṃ jagat tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasya sviddhanam
verses.en: Enveloped by the Lord must be This All—each thing that moves on earth. With that renounced enjoy thyself. Covet no wealth of any man.

verses.sa: कुर्वन्नेवेह कर्माणि जिजीविषेच्छतं समाः। एवं त्वयि नान्यथेतोऽस्ति न कर्म लिप्यते नरे॥
verses.tr: kurvanneveha karmāṇi jijīviṣecchataṃ samāḥ evaṃ tvayi nānyatheto'sti na karma lipyate nare
verses.en: One, only doing Karma here, should wish to live a hundred years. No way is there for thee but this. So Karma cleaveth not to man.

verses.sa: असुर्या नाम ते लोका अन्धेन तमसावृताः। ताँस्ते प्रेत्यापि गच्छन्ति ये के चात्महनो जनाः॥
verses.tr: asuryā nāma te lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ tāṃste pretyāpi gacchanti ye ke cātmahano janāḥ
verses.en: Aye, to the Asuras belong those worlds enwrapt in blinding gloom. To them, when life on earth is done, depart the man who kill the Self.

verses.sa: अनेजदेकं मनसो जवीयो नैनद्देवा आप्नुवन् पूर्वमर्शत्। तद्धावतोऽन्यानत्येति तिष्ठत्तस्मिन्नपो मातरिश्वा दधाति॥
verses.tr: anejadekaṃ manaso javīyo nainaddevā āpnuvan pūrvamarśat taddhāvato'nyānatyeti tiṣṭhattasminnapo mātariśvā dadhāti
verses.en: Motionless, one, swifter than Mind—the Devas failed to overtake it speeding on before them. It, standing still, outstrips the others running. Herein doth Matarisvan stablish Action.

verses.sa: तदेजति तन्नैजति तद्दूरे तद्वन्तिके। तदन्तरस्य सर्वस्य तदु सर्वस्यास्य बाह्यतः॥
verses.tr: tadejati tannaijati taddūre tadvantike tadantarasya sarvasya tadu sarvasyāsya bāhyataḥ
verses.en: It moveth; it is motionless. It is far distant; it is near. It is within This All; and it surrounds This All externally.

verses.sa: यस्तु सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मन्नेवानुपश्यति। सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ततो न वि चिकित्सति॥
verses.tr: yastu sarvāṇi bhūtānyātmannevānupaśyati sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ tato na vi cikitsati
verses.en: The man who in his Self beholds all creatures and all things that be, And in all beings sees his Self, thence doubts no longer, ponders not.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्त्सर्वाणि भूतान्यात्मैवाभूद्विजानतः। तत्र को मोहः कः शोक एकत्वमनुपश्यतः॥
verses.tr: yasmintsarvāṇi bhūtānyātmaivābhūdvijānataḥ tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śoka ekatvamanupaśyataḥ
verses.en: When, in the man who clearly knows, Self hath become all things that are. What wilderment, what grief is there in him who sees the One alone?

verses.sa: स पर्यगाच्छुक्रमकायमव्रणमस्नाविरं शुद्धमपापविद्धम्। कविर्मनीषी परिभूः स्वयम्भूर्याथातथ्यतोऽर्थान् व्यदधाच्छाश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sa paryagācchukramakāyamavraṇamasnāviraṃ śuddhamapāpaviddham kavirmanīṣī paribhūḥ svayambhūryāthātathyato'rthān vyadadhācchāśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ
verses.en: He hath attained unto the Bright, Bodiless, Woundless, Sinewless, the Pure which evil hath not pierced. Far-sighted, wise, encompassing, he self-existent hath prescribed aims, as propriety demands, unto the everlasting Years.

verses.sa: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽसंभूतिमुपासते। ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ सम्भूत्यां रताः॥
verses.tr: andhaṃ tamaḥ praviśanti ye'saṃbhūtimupāsate tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u sambhūtyāṃ ratāḥ
verses.en: Deep into shade of blinding gloom fall Asambhuti's worshippers. They sink to darkness deeper yet who on Sambhuti are intent.

verses.sa: अन्यदेवाहुः सम्भवादन्यदाहुरसम्भवात्। इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे॥
verses.tr: anyadevāhuḥ sambhavādanyadāhurasambhavāt iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nastadvicacakṣire
verses.en: One fruit, they say, from Sambhava, another from Asambhava. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.

verses.sa: सम्भूतिं च विनाशं च यस्तद्वेदोभयं सह। विनाशेन मृत्युं तीर्त्वा सम्भूत्यामृतमश्नुते॥
verses.tr: sambhūtiṃ ca vināśaṃ ca yastadvedobhayaṃ saha vināśena mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā sambhūtyāmṛtamaśnute
verses.en: The man who knows Sambhuti and Vinasa simultaneously, He, by Vinasa passing death, gains by Sambhuti endless life.

verses.sa: अन्धं तमः प्रविशन्ति येऽविद्यामुपासते। ततो भूय इव ते तमो य उ विद्यायां रताः॥
verses.tr: andhaṃ tamaḥ praviśanti ye'vidyāmupāsate tato bhūya iva te tamo ya u vidyāyāṃ ratāḥ
verses.en: To blinding darkness go the men who make a cult of Nescience. The devotees of Science enter darkness that is darker still.

verses.sa: अन्यदेवाहुर्विद्याया अन्यदाहुरविद्यायाः। इति शुश्रुम धीराणां ये नस्तद्विचचक्षिरे॥
verses.tr: anyadevāhurvidyāyā anyadāhuravidyāyāḥ iti śuśruma dhīrāṇāṃ ye nastadvicacakṣire
verses.en: Different is the fruit, they say, of Science and of Nescience. Thus from the sages have we heard who have declared this lore to us.

verses.sa: विद्यां चाविद्यां च यस्तद्वेदोभयं सह। अविद्यया मृत्युं तीर्त्वा विद्ययाऽमृतमश्नुते॥
verses.tr: vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhayaṃ saha avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayā'mṛtamaśnute
verses.en: The man who knoweth well these two, Science and Nescience, combined, Overcoming death by Nescience by Science gaineth endless life.

verses.sa: वायुरनिलममृतमथेदं भस्मान्तं शरीरम्। ओ३म् क्रतो स्मर। क्लिबे स्मर। कृतं स्मर॥
verses.tr: vāyuranilamamṛtamathedaṃ bhasmāntaṃ śarīram o3m krato smara klibe smara kṛtaṃ smara
verses.en: My breath reach everlasting Air! In ashes let my body end. Om! Mind, remember thou; remember thou my sphere; remember thou my deeds.

verses.sa: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान्। युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भुयिष्ठां ते नम उक्तिं विधेम॥
verses.tr: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhuyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema
verses.en: By goodly path lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest all our works and wisdom. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander; most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sa: हिरण्मयेन पात्रेण सत्यस्यापिहितं मुखम्। योऽसावादित्ये पुरुषः सोऽसावहम्। ओ३म् खं ब्रह्म॥
verses.tr: hiraṇmayena pātreṇa satyasyāpihitaṃ mukham yo'sāvāditye puruṣaḥ so'sāvaham o3m khaṃ brahma
verses.en: The real's face is hidden by a vessel formed of golden light. The Spirit yonder in the Sun, the Spirit dwelling there am I, Om! Heaven! Brahma!
